text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Biko 
Pegasus...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Biko Pegasus 
pointed, there was a crane game filled 
with plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It's Umamusume plushies! I wonder if they 
have ones of me or Bono!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: All riiiight! I'm definitely gonna get it!
choice_data_list: I'm rooting for you! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. Then again, maybe I'd better not.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I just decided not to waste any money 
because I really want the Carrotman belt. 
So, I have to stay strong...!
choice_data_list: Then I'll win it for you instead!
Then I'll win it for you instead!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?! You're sure you want to 
leave it to me?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, I'm counting on you, Trainer! I'll 
be cheering with everything I've got!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
